Which of the following statements regarding the administration of tribal areas under the Sixth Schedule of the Constitution is/are correct ?
i. It is applicable in all States where Scheduled Tribes make up more than 40% of the State's population.
ii. These areas are outside the authority of the State Legislature as well as State Executive.
iii. Only the President can organise and reorganise the autonomous districts in these areas.
iv. The High Court of the State does not have any jurisdiction in these areas.
official_questions.core_fact: The Sixth Schedule applies only to tribal areas of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram. These areas remain within the State's executive authority; the Governor organises/reorganises autonomous districts; the High Court retains jurisdiction as specified by the Governor.

statements.t: It is applicable in all States where STs make up more than 40% of the State's population.
statements.fact: Applies only to named tribal areas of 4 north-eastern States.

statements.t: These areas are outside the authority of the State Legislature as well as State Executive.
statements.fact: They lie within the State's executive authority; district councils only get legislative/judicial autonomy on listed matters.

statements.t: Only the President can organise and reorganise the autonomous districts in these areas.
statements.fact: The Governor organises and reorganises autonomous districts.

statements.t: The High Court of the State does not have any jurisdiction in these areas.
statements.fact: High Court jurisdiction over these areas continues to the extent specified by the Governor.

official_questions.rule: Sixth Schedule = Governor (not President) organises districts; Fifth Schedule = President declares Scheduled Areas.
